name: Standing hamstring curl

phases.name: left curl
phases.cue: Curl your left heel up behind you, pulling your elbows back

phases.name: left lower
phases.cue: Lower the foot and reach your arms forward

phases.name: right curl
phases.cue: Curl your right heel up, squeezing your shoulder blades

phases.name: right lower
phases.cue: Lower the foot and reach forward again

formTips: Keep the working thigh pointing down as the heel comes up
Squeeze the back of your thigh at the top
Pull your elbows back past your sides and squeeze your shoulder blades
Lean forward slightly with a flat back
commonMistakes: Swinging the knee forward instead of curling the heel
Letting the arms flap instead of pulling back
